capture.step1Desc: Seat the patient comfortably in a dimly lit area facing the camera.
capture.step1Tip: Tip: Dim lighting helps the patient's pupil dilate naturally.
capture.step2Desc: Keep the camera level and centered directly with the patient's eye.
capture.step2Tip: Tip: Ask the patient to fix their gaze on a distant target.
capture.step3Title: Make sure the retina is visible
capture.step3Desc: Check that the optic disc and retinal vessels appear sharp.
capture.step3Tip: Tip: Adjust distance smoothly until reflections disappear.
capture.step4Desc: Hold the camera steady and trigger the capture.
capture.step4Tip: Tip: Instruct the patient to keep wide open without blinking.
capture.step5Desc: Confirm illumination and focus before proceeding.
capture.step5Tip: Tip: Insufficient quality will require a retake.
capture.sampleDisclosure: Sample fundus image for demonstration purposes

quality.title: Image Quality Assessment
quality.passDesc: The retina, optic disc, and blood vessels are clearly visible for screening.
quality.failTitle: Image needs to be captured again
quality.failTooDark: The image is too dark. Retinal blood vessels are obscured by inadequate illumination.
quality.failBlurry: The image is blurred or out of focus. Fine retinal details cannot be evaluated.
quality.tipDark: Tip: Ensure the lens light is active and ambient light does not cast shadows.
quality.tipBlur: Tip: Ask the patient to hold still and refocus the lens before capturing.

upload.onlineDesc: Keep this screen open until the screening image is safely transmitted.
upload.offlineDesc: No internet connection is available right now. Your screening is safely stored in local memory and will upload automatically when connectivity returns.
